paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Expert win rates 0.90\% in EBS feedback judgment. Our annotations achieve an average win rate of 88.890.90\%. All 12 LLMs exceed an 820.90\% rate in preferring our EBS.

model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the expert win rate percentages for twelve large language models (LLMs) and an average baseline, as determined by EBS feedback judgment. The horizontal axis displays the names of each LLM and the average, listed alphabetically from “Average” to “GLM-4-Plus.” The vertical axis represents “Expert Win Rate (%)” on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 100 with tick marks at 20-unit intervals.  Each LLM is represented by a grey bar, with the “Average” represented by a darker grey bar. The “Average” bar reaches approximately 88.89%, while the “GPT-4-turbo” bar extends to approximately 91.67%. The “Claude 3 Opus” bar reaches 97.14%, the tallest value represented in the chart, while “DeepSeek-V3” bar is the shortest bar at around 82.26%. All bars are arranged adjacent to each other, and no bars appear to be visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations. The chart includes numeric values displayed directly above each bar indicating the exact win rate percentage.
model_annotations.German: This bar chart illustrates the expert win rate for twelve large language models, along with an average rate. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which are labels for each model—Average, GPT-4o, GPT-4-turbo, GPT-4o-mini, Claude 3 Opus, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama-3.1-405B, Mistral Large, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen-Max, and GLM-4-Plus—presented in a specific order without apparent sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “Expert Win Rate (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels appearing at 20-unit intervals. Each model is represented by a solid-colored bar; the bars range in height from approximately 82.26% for DeepSeek-V3 to 97.56% for Claude 3 Opus. The ‘Average’ bar is a dark grey color and extends to 88.89%, while the remaining bars are each a different shade of grey, lavender, or beige. Each bar is annotated with its precise win rate value. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations beyond the numerical value.
